<!--

issue_context.title: Jellyfin media browser show share password and failed on stub files
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hello,

When I browse Jellyfin medias from Home-Assistant, I have this error `Unable to determine mime type for path \\user:password@ip\path\to\the\problematic\file` and two problems:
  - the user/password are shown in he error message
  - the media browser failed on stub files (I create empty file like `My Movie (2022).bluray.disc" to add my physical movie in my Jellyfin library). I think Home-Assistant Media browser should skip files with no mime type.

Thank you

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2736322/200767724-8f81aaee-9dce-4915-89e5-8cf506a39553.png)

thanks for the report, I will try to review over the next weekend or Thanksgiving break.

I've opened a PR for this issue. Upon merging the integration will ignore files for which no mime type can be determined. It will print only the file name at debug level to the log to prevent printing possible username/password information in the file path.

review_comments: Do we need to handle missing mime type in `_build_track` too?

And that's why we review... Yes, of course. Thanks!
